title: Email already registered
why: Checks that email uniqueness is case-insensitive, so one passenger cannot register twice with different casing.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user for a second passenger with FirstName Annabel, LastName Meier, Email 'Anna.Meyer@Example.com' (same address, different case), UserName annabel.meier, PassPortNumber DE1112223, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword.

expect: Rejected with a duplicate-email error. Only the original User row (existing-anna) remains and no second row is created.
